headline.purpose: Open chorale title in the top bar; library section heads at 1.625rem.

title.purpose: Shelf item titles; table row titles at 1.1875rem.

lyric.purpose: Sung words and German first lines, always italic.

label-strong.purpose: Primary and outline buttons, chip names, legends.

mono.purpose: BWV and Riemenschneider numbers, tempo, bar and phrase numbers, tags.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Popovers, hint bubbles and notices only (light).

shadows.name: float-dark
shadows.purpose: Same role in the organ-loft dark theme.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, colour and press changes on controls and chips.

motion.name: hint-in
motion.purpose: Hints and notices rise 4px and fade in.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: 1ms; canvas steps a phrase at a time

highContrast.purpose: ink-2 and ink-3 collapse to ink; rules strengthen; canvas voices gain dash patterns S solid, A 7-4, T 2-3, B 9-3-2-3.

components.name: Play Button
components.description: The one primary action: start and pause the music.
components.html: <button class="ds-play"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6.5 4.2v11.6a.6.6 0 0 0 .9.5l9.3-5.8a.6.6 0 0 0 0-1L7.4 3.7a.6.6 0 0 0-.9.5Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>Play</button>
components.css: .ds-play { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; min-width: 9.5rem; padding: 0 1.4rem 0 1.15rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.0625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms var(--ease-out), background-color 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-play:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 86%, var(--paper)); } .ds-play:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary text action; inverts to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-text-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-button:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-text-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Loop Toggle
components.description: Quiet pill toggle; on state takes a 2px ink border.
components.css: .ds-loop { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-loop:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-loop.is-on { border: 2px solid var(--ink); padding: 0 calc(0.95rem - 1px); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; } .ds-loop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Options"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6h7m4 0h1M4 14h1m4 0h7M13 4v4M7 12v4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms var(--ease-out), color 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--grid); color: var(--ink); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: Lens and view switcher; selected is an ink press.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--paper); } .ds-segmented button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 0.95rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-segmented button:not(:disabled):not([aria-pressed="true"]):hover { background: var(--grid); color: var(--ink); } .ds-segmented button:disabled { color: var(--ink-3); opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Voice Chip
components.description: Signature: tap to mute, hold to solo; letter, name, state and level.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip { position: relative; flex: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 12px 4px; border: 2px solid var(--c); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 7%, var(--sheet)); color: var(--ink); text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; transition: background-color 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 13%, var(--sheet)); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-letter { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); color: var(--sheet); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-chip-name { font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-state { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-chip-level { position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: 5px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 18%, transparent); overflow: hidden; } .ds-chip-level span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--c); transform-origin: left; } .ds-chip.is-silent { border-style: dashed; background: transparent; } .ds-chip.is-silent .ds-chip-letter { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--c); color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-chip.is-silent .ds-chip-name { color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-solo { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; min-height: 56px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-solo:hover { background: var(--grid); color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Library search: pill on sheet with a leading icon.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; width: 26rem; max-width: 100%; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 0.8rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 0.9rem 0 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); opacity: 1; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Mono figure box for loop count, tempo and stretch.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Shelf Cell
components.description: Ruled library cell under a 2px ink rule; not a card.
components.html:
O Haupt voll Blut und Wunden

O head, full of blood and wounds

D minor · 8 phrases
components.css: .ds-shelf { border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); width: 14rem; } .ds-shelf-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-shelf-item:hover { background: var(--sheet); } .ds-shelf-item h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-tr { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-meta { margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-preview { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; align-self: flex-start; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 0 0.9rem 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-preview:hover { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-preview:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hint Bubble
components.description: Floating ink note; one at a time, after the music starts.
components.html: Tap a voice to mute it. Press and hold to hear it alone.
components.css: .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 22rem; padding: 6px 4px 6px 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.9375rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow); animation: ds-hint-in 320ms var(--ease-out) both; } .ds-hint button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--paper); cursor: pointer; } .ds-hint button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 18%, transparent); } .ds-hint button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-hint-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } }

narrative.overview:
The chorale itself is the interface. Four voice-coloured ribbons run across a quiet paper field under one fixed ink playhead, and the music moves beneath it. Everything around the music is paper, ink and hairline rules: a printed hymnal's index and a conductor's stand, not a mixing desk. Colour is reserved for the voices so that when a line is coloured, it is singing.

Density is calm but working: one slim top bar, a left rail of four voice chips, a full-bleed canvas, a docked transport. Titles carry the period in IM Fell English; every control speaks in Atkinson Hyperlegible; sung words appear in Spectral Italic; numbers and pitch names sit in IBM Plex Mono. Depth comes from rules and tonal steps (paper to sheet), never from stacked cards. The world runs in two lights, daylight paper (#eef0f3) and organ-loft dark (#111319), with brighter voice variants in the dark.

Motion follows the music only. Interface state changes are short (120ms) fades of background and colour; the canvas glides with playback, or steps a phrase at a time under reduced motion and on portrait phones.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and ink ground; four voice hues used for voices and nothing else; plum only in the tension gauge.
Fixed playhead, moving music; fermatas are the loop controls.
Hairline 1px rules for structure; a 2px ink rule opens a list or a prompt.
Selection reads as an ink press: ink fill, paper text.
Colour never works alone: voice letters everywhere, dashed outlines for silence, dash patterns in high contrast.

rules.name: The Voice-Only Rule
rules.body: Vermilion, ochre, teal and indigo mean soprano, alto, tenor and bass. They never decorate, never mark state, never brand a button.

rules.name: The One Plum Rule
rules.body: Clash plum appears only in the tension gauge.

rules.name: The Letter Beside the Colour Rule
rules.body: Every voice colour is accompanied by its letter (S A T B) on chips and at each phrase start on the canvas; a silent voice is dashed and struck through, not just faded.

rules.name: The Four Hands Rule
rules.body: Each family has one job. Fell for titles of chorales and sections only, never for controls or body; Spectral Italic only for sung or German text; Plex Mono only for numbers and pitch names; Atkinson for everything else.

rules.name: The German With English Rule
rules.body: A German line is always followed by its translation in ink-2 sans, directly beneath.

rules.name: The Fixed Playhead Rule
rules.body: The playhead never moves; the music moves under it.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface casts a shadow only if it floats over the music. Resting surfaces, rows, shelf cells and chips stay flat.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Lists and regions are separated by 1px rules, not boxed in cards. A 2px ink rule marks where a list begins.

dos: Do keep voice colours for voices: chips, ribbons, score noteheads, the mark.
Do pair every voice colour with its letter, and dash a silent voice.
Do show selection as an ink press: ink fill, paper text.
Do separate content with 1px rules and open lists with a 2px ink rule.
Do set chorale titles in IM Fell English and sung or German text in Spectral Italic, with an English translation beneath.
Do put numbers, tempo and pitch names in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep every target at least 44px and every state change at 120ms ease-out.
Do derive voice tints with `color-mix` into sheet (7%, 13%, 20%).
donts: Don't use vermilion, ochre, teal or indigo for buttons, links, status or decoration.
Don't use clash plum anywhere but the tension gauge.
Don't put a shadow on a resting surface; only popovers, hints and notices float.
Don't box content in cards; shelves and tables are ruled, not carded.
Don't set controls or body copy in Fell, or numbers in the interface sans.
Don't animate the interface for its own sake; motion follows the music.
Don't use parchment textures, portraits, mascots, badges or confetti.
